; Cover Sleep Screen v4.3 for reMarkable OS 3.27.x
; Uses xochitl's native LastOpen state in xochitl.conf via the helper service.
; This QMD only changes the sleep-screen source:
;   /home/root/.cover-sleep/current.png if present
;   otherwise the stock/reManager SleepScreenPath.

AFFECT [[15136737896827182809]]
    IMPORT Qt.labs.folderlistmodel [[180923.180922]]

    TRAVERSE [[7711468349764991]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER [[5972374]]
        INSERT {
            FolderListModel {
                ~&5972374&~: coverSleepFiles
                ~&7082663378949&~: "file:///home/root/.cover-sleep/"
                nameFilters: ["current.png"]
                showDirs: ~&214625660372&~
            }
        }

        REBUILD [[16364404249624396525]]
            LOCATE BEFORE STREAM \ ~&7083121450889&~ \
            INSERT {
                ~&197091758&~ ~&214622615378&~ = coverSleepFiles.~&214622615378&~;
                ~&5972376&~ (~&214622615378&~ > 0) {
                    ~&6504167510&~ = coverSleepFiles.~&197086313&~(0, "fileUrl");
                }
            }
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE

    ; If current.png does not exist, keep the normal SleepScreenPath selected
    ; by xochitl/reManager.
    TRAVERSE ?#[[16041628731068125427]]
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        REBUILD [[233748328658231]]
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT { coverSleepFiles.~&214622615378&~ === 0 && }
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
